[{"insert":"Split Stance DB RDL

The split stance dumbbell RDL sets one foot slightly back so the front leg carries most of the load, which lets you train each hamstring and glute on its own. Hold the dumbbells close to your legs, push the front hip straight back, and feel the stretch down the back of that front thigh before you stand tall. Keep a soft front knee and a flat back, and only lower as far as your hamstrings allow. Reps climb by one per side from Week 2, so hold a strong load while you add the extra volume.
"}]
